description: Register an Auth0Resource (OAuth2 client_credentials grant against an M2M application) wrapping the Auth0 Management API's user endpoints for use by other components. Exposes only find/create/update/block -- never delete.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Auth0 M2M application's Client ID (scopes: read:users, create:users, update:users).

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the M2M application's Client Secret.

name: Auth0 Resource
